model_output.verdict: An experienced elementary teacher whose classroom work, reading results and grade-level leadership are easy to see.
write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for elementary teaching roles. A recruiter can see your class size, work with English language learners and leadership of the grade-level team. The reading growth line is especially strong because it shows what changed over three years on the district assessment.

This resume isn't going to be the reason you don't hear back. How competitive a teaching job is will matter too. The one line I'd add to is your positive behavior support committee work, so a recruiter can see what you contributed.

cards.line: - Raised the class's average reading growth on the district assessment from 0.8 to 1.4 grade levels per year over three years
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model: it names the assessment, the starting point and the change. A recruiter doesn't have to guess what the reading work achieved.

cards.where: 2nd Grade Teacher, positive behavior support committee
cards.line: - Served on the school's positive behavior support committee
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see you served on the committee, but not what you contributed to its work.
cards.example: Served on the school's positive behavior support committee and [contribution]
cards.question: What did you contribute to the committee's work?

fit.level: Experienced elementary teacher and grade-level lead
fit.note: Your experience points to elementary classroom teaching, with grade-level planning and teacher training alongside it. Your Washington K-8 certification and English Language Learner endorsement are easy to find.
